dialogue.speaker: Ashe
dialogue.text: Could you teach me about other meats too? I want to learn properly.

dialogue.speaker: Dedue
dialogue.text: Ashe. Why do you choose to spend time with me?

dialogue.speaker: Ashe
dialogue.text: Because we're friends, aren't we? I want to know you better. Is that strange?
